specialAbilities.name: Pack Tactics

specialAbilities.name: Elusive
specialAbilities.desc: No attack roll has advantage against Lazav unless he is incapacitated.

specialAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
specialAbilities.desc: If Lazav fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

specialAbilities.name: Shapechanger Savant
specialAbilities.desc: Lazav can use a bonus action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid he has seen. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

specialAbilities.name: Psychic Defenses
specialAbilities.desc: Unless Lazav is incapacitated, he is immune to magic that allows other creatures to read his thoughts, determine whether he is lying, know his alignment, or know his creature type. Creatures can telepathically communicate with Lazav only if he allows it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Lazav makes three shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: mw 13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 10 (1d6 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before Lazav's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Attack
legendaryActions.desc: Lazav makes a weapon attack.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Lazav casts one of his innate spells.

legendaryActions.name: Shifting Nightmare (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Lazav rapidly takes the form of several nightmarish creatures, lashing out at all nearby. Each creature within 10 feet of Lazav must succeed on a 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) damage of a type chosen by Lazav: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or necrotic.

specialAbilities.name: Aura of Blood Lust
specialAbilities.desc: When any other creature starts its turn within 30 feet of the master, that creature must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw, or it must immediately take the Attack action, making one melee attack against a random creature within reach. If no creatures are within reach, it makes a ranged attack against a random creature within range, throwing its weapon if necessary.

specialAbilities.name: Feed on the Crowd
specialAbilities.desc: Whenever a creature within 60 feet of the master dies, the master gains 15 temporary hit points and has advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

specialAbilities.name: Magic Resistance
specialAbilities.desc: The master has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The master makes two melee attacks with its spear.

actions.name: Spear

actions.name: Captivating Presence Recharge
actions.desc: Each creature within 120 feet of the master must succeed on a 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the master for 1 hour. While charmed in this way, a creature's speed is 0. If the charmed creature takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Captivating Presence of all masters of cruelties for the next 24 hours.

specialAbilities.name: Shadow Stealth
specialAbilities.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the vampire can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

specialAbilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
specialAbilities.desc: While in sunlight, the vampire has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained. 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: mw 6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The vampire can also grapple the target (escape 13) if it is a creature and the vampire has a hand free.

actions.name: Mind Siphon 5
actions.desc: The vampire targets a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must make a 14 Intelligence saving throw, with disadvantage if the vampire has previously consumed the target's blood. On a failed save, the target takes 28 (8d6) psychic damage, and the vampire discerns the target's surface emotions and thoughts. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage, and the vampire discerns the target's general emotional state but not its thoughts.

specialAbilities.name: Special Equipment
specialAbilities.desc: The mage wears a Spies' Murmur|GGR|spies' murmur (see chapter 5).

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: mw,rw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

specialAbilities.name: Mount
specialAbilities.desc: If the specter isn't mounted, it can use a bonus action to magically teleport onto its gloamwing mount, provided the specter and the gloamwing are on the same plane of existence. When it teleports, the specter appears astride the gloamwing along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying. While mounted and not incapacitated, the specter can't be surprised, and both it and its mount gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The specter makes two scythe attacks.

actions.name: Scythe
actions.desc: mw 8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) psychic damage.

actions.name: Mind Twist 5
actions.desc: The specter magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 22 (5d8) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Reap Memory (3/Day)
actions.desc: The specter touches one incapacitated creature and chooses 1 hour from among the past 24. Unless the creature succeeds on a 15 Intelligence saving throw, the creature loses all memory of that hour. The creature regains the memory only if the specter dies within the next 24 hours.

specialAbilities.name: Locus of the Firemind
specialAbilities.desc: Niv-Mizzet can maintain concentration on two different spells at the same time. In addition, he has advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration on spells.

specialAbilities.name: Magic Resistance
specialAbilities.desc: Niv-Mizzet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

specialAbilities.name: Master Chemister
specialAbilities.desc: When Niv-Mizzet casts a spell that deals damage, he can change the spell's damage to cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Niv-Mizzet makes three attacks: one with his bite and two with his claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: mw 17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. 18 (2d8 + 9) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: mw 17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 14 (2d4 + 9) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: mw 17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 16 (2d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath 5
actions.desc: Niv-Mizzet exhales fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 91 (26d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryActions.name: Cantrip
legendaryActions.desc: Niv-Mizzet casts one of his cantrips.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Attack
legendaryActions.desc: Niv-Mizzet makes a tail attack.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Niv-Mizzet beats his wings. Each creature within 15 feet of him must succeed on a 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (2d4 + 9) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Niv-Mizzet can then fly up to half his flying speed.

legendaryActions.name: Dracogenius (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Niv-Mizzet regains a spell slot of 3rd level or lower.

The ghost has a trait based on who it is, as shown below:
Enezesku: Enfeebling Ray
Fautomni: Undead Fortitude
Karlov: Unnatural Vigor
Vuliev: Teleportation
Xil Xaxosz: Lingering Spite

specialAbilities.name: Ethereal Sight
specialAbilities.desc: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

specialAbilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
specialAbilities.desc: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain||3. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

specialAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
specialAbilities.desc: If the ghost fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Convene the Ghost Council
actions.desc: The ghost summons the other four members of the Obzedat. At the start of the ghost's next turn, the other members appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the summoner. The ghosts each roll initiative when they appear.

legendaryActions.name: Forced Obedience
legendaryActions.desc: A target that all of the Obzedat ghosts can see must succeed on a 16 Wisdom saving throw or bow until the end of its next turn. Until this bow ends, the target can't take actions or reactions, and its speed is 0 and can't be increased.

legendaryActions.name: Indentured Spirits (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The Obzedat ghosts conjure 1d6 indentured spirit|ggr|indentured spirits (described in this chapter) within 60 feet of one of them.

specialAbilities.name: Focus
specialAbilities.desc: As a bonus action, the giant can target a creature it can see within 30 feet of it and make that creature its focus. The target remains the giant's focus for 1 minute, or until either the target or the giant drops to 0 hit points. When the giant makes an attack roll against its focus, it adds a d4 to its attack roll. If the giant attacks a different target while it has a focus, it subtracts a d4 from its attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two greataxe attacks.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 25 (3d12 + 6) slashing damage. If the Orzhov giant scores a critical hit, it rolls the damage dice three times, instead of twice.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: rw 9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
